services.name: Snowmobile to Ice Cave Tour
services.desc: Come try out our Snowmobile to Ice Cave Tour! Duration 7 Hours About Have you ever dreamed of going to an Ice Cave that has ice that is 10,000-20,000 years old? Come riding with us and explore some newly discovered Ice Caves on the Pemberton Ice Cap just outside Whistler. These caves, the scenery, and the riding are absolutely stunning! This is truly a trip of a lifetime and is great for a family, corporate activity, company party, or stag activity. This snowmobile tour is for riders who have previous snowmobile experience. Duration Full Day About Hire one of our local pro guides to take you on a full-day tour to one of our many amazing tenured riding areas. Explore endless terrain on one of our Timbersled Snowbikes.
